name: Knowledge Assistant
description: Ask me about the documents in this knowledge base. I search all of them and combine what I find into one answer, with its sources so you can check it. If the documents don't cover a question (like "What is AI?"), I say so instead of guessing.

topics.title: RAG design
topics.description: Chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, recommended defaults
examples: How are dense and BM25 results merged in hybrid search?

topics.title: LLM evaluation
topics.description: Retrieval metrics, LLM-as-judge, golden sets, release gates
examples: How is MRR defined in the evaluation playbook?
What is the release gate threshold for Recall@5?

topics.title: Agent design
topics.description: Tool calling, multi-agent patterns, human approval rules
examples: Which multi-agent topology is approved for production?
Which agent actions require human approval?

topics.title: Model selection
topics.description: Model tiers per use case, cost caps, approvals
examples: Which model tier is approved for document classification and what is its cost cap?
Which models may process data classified as Confidential-Restricted?

topics.title: Prompt & engineering practices
topics.description: Prompt standards, model call policies, code review rules
examples: What temperature should be used by default for question answering prompts?
What timeout and retry policy must client code use when calling models?

topics.title: LLM operations & incidents
topics.description: Hallucination spikes, prompt injection, cost overruns, error codes
examples: What does error code LUM-2001 mean?
Which kill switch disables side-effecting agent tools during a prompt injection incident?
